guide_solution: Section A : Reading Test Made Easy to SSC English Test Papers 12. Dialogue writing A dialogue between myself and my friend about how to eradicate illiteracy problem from our country. See Safiuddin Sarker Academy and College, Tongi, Gazipur. Sl. No. 20; Page No. 68  Title : Facing a critical situation See Rangpur Zilla Schooli. Sl. No. 50; Page No. 100 10. Graph & charts The graph focuses on the number of mobile phone users in Bangladesh. From this graph, we may understand that in 2010, 30% users used the mobile phone. In 2011, 35% users, in 2012, 45% users, in 2013, 60% users, and in 2014, 80% users used the mobile phones in Bangladesh. In this way it is seen from the graph that the using rate of mobile phones in Bangladesh gradually increasing. Mobile phones were used the least in 2010 since users started using mobile phones. And in 2014 the using rate of mobile phones was the most increasing. On the whole the graph highlights the number of mobile phone users in Bangladesh. 11. Letter writing A letter to my friend describing my aim in life. See R.B. Govt. High School, Joypurhat. Sl. No. 48; Page No. 99 12. Dialogue writing Dialogue between myself and my friend, Ahad on merits and demerits of Digital Bangladesh. Myself : Hello Ahad, how are you? Ahad : I am fine and you? Myself : I am also fine. But why do you look excited? Ahad : You are right. I am somewhat excited about Digital Bangladesh. Myself : Oh, Yes! I am also. People are not aware of it that our country is advancing towards being digitalized. Ahad : You are absolutely right. The idea of Digital Bangladesh is the brainschild of our honorable Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. She is working hard to materialize this. Myself : Exactly! But what are you thinking about its consequences? Ahad : The consequence of Digital Bangladesh will be amazing. But at the same time will have some problem. Because you know that there is no unmixed blessing on earth. Myself : Absolutely! Besides, it has some merits and demerits. Ahad : I agree with you. Besides, I think that people can connect themselves nowadays easily which was once a dream. But our student folk are going to be devastated by it. Myself : Exactly! Besides, they use social media at random as this has no noticeable expense. Ahad : Yes, of course. Besides, the criminal are doing blackmailing by electronic ways. Myself : You are right. But what can we do to prevent the bad sides of Digital Bangladesh? Ahad : The people from all walks of life should come forward and they should realize the good sides of Digital Bangladesh and inform other people about it. And then demerits will disappear from the society. Myself : Right you are! Thank you. Ahad : You are most welcome. See you later.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 1) : First Paper  Solutions See Mymensingh Zilla School. Sl. No. 21; Page No. 68
